description:
Decision needed: should the workspace propagate the jmap-base-client Debug-redaction precedent (manual impl Debug that prints type name + field count, hiding contents) from credential-bearing types to PII-bearing types across all sibling type crates?

## Background

jmap-base-client implements manual redacting Debug on credential-bearing types:
- BearerAuth (request.rs, line ~244)
- BasicAuth (request.rs, line ~244)
- Session (request.rs, line ~244)
- AccountInfo (request.rs, line ~340)

The workspace 'Security testing' section in AGENTS.md formalizes the per-type Debug redaction canary pattern (a unit test that constructs the type with a canary literal and asserts the canary does not appear in format!("{value:?}") output).

This precedent is **NOT** applied to:
- jmap-mail-types (Email, EmailAddress, EmailHeader, ...)
- jmap-contacts-types (ContactCard, AddressBook, ...)
- jmap-jscontact-types (Name, EmailAddress, Phone, Address, Note, Anniversary, PersonalInfo, CryptoKey, ...)
- jmap-calendars-types (CalendarEvent, ...)
- jmap-jscalendar-types (...)
- jmap-chat-types (Message, Chat, Space, ...)
- jmap-tasks-types (Task, ...)
- jmap-metadata-types (Metadata, Annotation, ...)

These all derive plain Debug. A downstream consumer writing
```rust
tracing::debug!(card = ?contact_card, "fetched contact");
```
emits every name, phone, email, postal address, note, and CryptoKey URI to the log sink. This is PII (GDPR Article 5, CCPA §1798.100) but not credential-grade.

## Trigger

bd:JMAP-glx8.26 — the per-crate docs-only finding on jmap-contacts-types that surfaced the workspace-wide gap.

## Options

(a) Status quo: derive plain Debug everywhere. Document the leak in each crate's '# Logging safety' rustdoc section (already landed for jmap-contacts-types in JMAP-glx8.26). Tell consumers to wrap PII in a redacting newtype.

(b) Propagate manual-redacting-Debug + redaction-canary test to every PII-bearing type in every sibling type crate. Single workspace-wide policy. ~40 types across 8 crates. Each type's Debug prints "TypeName { ... }" without contents.

(c) Two-tier policy: credential-bearing types keep the existing manual-redacting impl (jmap-base-client only); PII-bearing types in type crates get a feature-gated redacting impl behind a 'redact' feature, off by default. Consumers opt in.

## Recommendation

Option (a) is what landed in JMAP-glx8.26 (docs-only, deferred to this bead for the workspace decision). Mark to confirm the workspace posture before any sibling-type-crate work happens. Option (b) is the symmetric high-confidence choice but is the most invasive — ~40 manual impl blocks and ~40 canary tests across 8 crates. Option (c) splits the difference but adds a feature flag to every type crate, which the workspace has so far avoided.

## Scope

Each option ships as a separate sweep epic if chosen:
- (a) — close this bead, no further action.
- (b) — sweep epic per type crate (8 crates), each child file the manual impl + canary test for every PII-bearing type.
- (c) — workspace-level Cargo.toml change + same per-crate sweep but feature-gated.

Cross-reference:
- workspace AGENTS.md 'Security testing' section
- jmap-base-client/src/request.rs (redacting Debug precedent)
- jmap-base-client/tests/log_redaction.rs (canary test pattern)
- bd:JMAP-glx8.26 (per-crate trigger)
title: Workspace policy: Debug redaction for PII-bearing types in type crates
